title: Make sure it will fit in your cabinet!
text: Make sure it will fit in your cabinet!. Mine did not come with the suction cups as advertised and there wasn't a way to contact the seller. I'll just make do I guess cuz it still works. The pieces are put together as you can see in the photo, it separated taking it out of the box. I was able to put it back together carefully but I can see how one could break it doing so. It sits on the edge (frame) of the cabinet door because it's a bit too long for my cabinets. It's still useable though and helps keep my spices organized and saves space. I can see that it could be useful for medication bottles too
